source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: This ability is always written Scouts X". During Resolve Pre-battle Abilities, a unit whose models all have it may take exactly one of three options. (1) A unit in **[Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)** can be set up anywhere wholly within your own deployment zone. (2) A unit standing wholly within your own deployment zone may perform a **[Scout move](vsdata:core-rule/scout-move)** under 24.32. (3) A unit aboard a DEDICATED TRANSPORT that stands wholly within your own deployment zone, where every model aboard that DEDICATED TRANSPORT has Scouts, lets that DEDICATED TRANSPORT perform a **[Scout move](vsdata:core-rule/scout-move)**.

options.where: anywhere wholly within own deployment zone

options.state: embarked within a DEDICATED TRANSPORT wholly within own deployment zone
options.requires: every model embarked in that DEDICATED TRANSPORT has Scouts
